verdict.rationale: Factory ships an official Droid CLI with a documented quickstart for installation and an interactive terminal UI. The CLI covers project context, approvals, MCP tools, Missions and slash commands, and adds a headless `droid exec` mode with structured I/O and tiered autonomy for CI/CD and scripts. A probe confirms the official CLI documentation page exists. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI working as documented.
